pairedWith: wavy chips and French onion dip!
thoughts: this is the perfectly balanced orange wine. I feel like I used to not like orange wines as much but I must have had some great luck since I have some great ones lately! I didn't even know Georgia (the country) was coming with grapes like this!!! Apparently Georgia has some of the oldest wine producing land and this is one of the oldest grape varieties in the world. There's still so much to learn about the world!!! I can def tell this grape is grown in super rich soil, the notes really sing here. I would also probably pair this with a very creamy cheese, maybe a goat cheese? Loved this so much.

verdict: solid riesling, good for acid lovers who don't want to go full orange
pairedWith: club crackers and a glazed donut
thoughts: this is my Thanksgiving eve wine pick! I'm running low on white wines personally so I ran to my local wine shop and I always head straight to the Riesling shelf. This wine is nothing crazy special but I really enjoyed the high acidity here. There's a little syrup-y sweetness on the end of the palate if you hold it in your mouth for a bit, so that's fun. Eating it with a donut definitely tamped down both the sweetness in the donut and acidity in this wine so that was a great pairing. Not sure if I would serve this for thanksgiving dinner since it's so sharp but would drink it after!
